verdict.rationale: Anytype is local-first, offline-capable, and end-to-end encrypted with no cloud AI training on user content by design (data stored locally, 'not even Anytype can see your content'), which inherently prevents platform-side AI training on user data. However, there is no explicit policy statement addressing AI training use, and the product's AI integrations (MCP, agents-skill) route data to third-party AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Gemini) whose own training policies are outside Anytype's control and undocumented here. missing for 10: an explicit anti-AI-training policy statement, clarity on third-party AI assistant data handling/training opt-out, and independent confirmation no telemetry/content is used for model training.
